title: Space-Creating versus Dead Possession: An Off-Ball Possession-Quality Index for Broadcast Football
description: Event-side junk-possession index and spatial Space-Creation Index (SCI) for distinguishing space-creating from dead possession in broadcast football. Includes the index, validation battery (correlations, out-of-sample tests, and VAEP non-reducibility regression with match-clustered standard errors), and tournament-scale spatial verification.
